escena: SCENE (team portrait, Ciudad de México, a strategy director between two client sessions): a striking editorial portrait of a Mexican woman in her late thirties, short dark hair, plain charcoal knit, seated, turned three-quarters, looking out of frame to the left with calm intensity; a hard low key light from the left from a window OUTSIDE the frame on the left throws crisp graphic stripes of light and shadow across her face and knit; the blinds themselves are never in the frame, the far side of her face in open shadow; a rim from a second low source behind separates her hair from the wall. 135mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook under her hand carries the only blue. Contemporary room: a bare, evenly shadowed dark plaster wall behind her; no plants, no books, no framed art, no lamps, no shelves anywhere in the frame, not even out of focus. The desk holds only her notebook and a current thin laptop, closed. Nobody looks at the lens. The LEFT 30% of the frame, from top to bottom, is only the bare, evenly shadowed dark plaster wall and the dark desk: no window, no blinds, no bright edge, nothing in it.

lecho.objeto: the edge of a dark oiled-wood desk on the camera side, dissolved into blur and outside every beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed plaster wall
